authorization: Owner requested professional hcloud rebenchmark scenarios on a 16-vCPU machine; no feature work or default flip authorized.
baseline_interpretation: Report legacy-to-final and post-parity-to-final separately: correctness work changed the required read work before allocation optimization. Client production/dependency inputs are unchanged between legacy and post-parity, verified by Git diff; the client binary retains its actual post-parity source identity.

runtime.guest_topology: AMD EPYC Milan; eight exported cores, two SMT threads per core; one NUMA node
runtime.affinity_evidence: lscpu and thread_siblings_list verify complete disjoint sibling groups; guest affinity is not a claim of physical host isolation
runtime.cluster: one dedicated FDB process; single redundancy; SSD engine for client; memory engine for Record Layer and SQL; no other workload during timing
runtime.network: private host/client veth; client network namespace has no default route; server binds only 172.31.99.1:4500; baseline has no artificial delay

sample_policy.four_arm_orders: two randomized complete Williams-square repetitions, preregistered before timing
sample_policy.unit_of_resampling: whole balanced block, keeping within-process repeats clustered
sample_policy.uncertainty: nominal 95% paired block-bootstrap intervals and raw per-run results; client p99 comes from per-transaction samples, testing.B means are not p99
sample_policy.exclusions: No post-hoc outlier removal; warmup is predefined and separate; all adverse/aborted runs retained. No repeated campaigns to obtain favorable results. Any environmental failure is diagnosed and a new protocol/campaign version identifies the restart.
sample_policy.performance_decision: No automatic default flip or fixed minimum improvement policy. Report uncertainty, order effects and regressions; no aggregate speedup fabricated across workloads.
sample_policy.data_generation: No random data seed: frozen payload algorithms and exact ID ranges; arm namespaces differ but have equal byte lengths.
sample_policy.absolute_estimand: Median of run-level statistics; do not pool transaction percentiles across processes.
sample_policy.relative_estimand: For each case/metric, take median of the three within-process testing.B repeats per arm/block, then geometric mean of within-block numerator/denominator ratios. Client has one process per arm/block and uses that process statistic. Bootstrap resamples whole paired block log-ratios.
sample_policy.interval_limits: Nominal exploratory percentile block-bootstrap 95% intervals, 20000 resamples, seed391706; six/eight independent blocks have limited resolution; no noninferiority, equivalence, production-capacity or multiplicity-adjusted claim.
sample_policy.testing_b_scope: Classic B keeps existing timed result checks byte-identical across trees and adds untimed reset/post-write validation. New C/D loops stop the timer for explicit validation. Reported testing.B means/B-op follow those scopes, not whole-process throughput or p99; raw process CPU/wall time is retained separately.
sample_policy.client_scope: Closed-loop completion latency includes retries, materialization and exact byte checks. p99 comparisons use run-level quantiles and paired blocks, not individual transactions as independent replicates. Go allocations exclude native libfdb_c heap. Lifecycle CPU scopes retain the clientbench definitions.

execution_gates: All required binaries built before any timing; no compilation, profiling, downloads, package installation or other workload during a measurement phase.
Identical benchmark and client harness bytes across comparable production revisions; archive baseline plus benchmark-only overlay, actual compiler/build info and complete hashes.

Correctness/path audits run outside timing: exact ordered IDs, payload/checksum, actual split chunk count, nonempty populations, noncovering plan and expected remote/index/load counters. Logical counters are not asserted as wire RPC counts.
Fresh processes and equal-length namespaces; fixtures prepared and cleared outside timed windows. Preserve physical prefix/schema evidence to detect key-length confounds.
Background CPU, steal, memory, disk and network telemetry at 1 Hz; no performance-profile instrumentation in timing.
Only one owned cluster configuration active; no CI runners or shared production data touched.
Before a phase, require enough remaining lifetime for its preregistered wall cap plus artifact collection; otherwise mark the whole phase unexecuted for budget, never silently reduce sample count.
Collect and verify raw artifacts on controller, then delete only server <server-id> with exact campaign labels. Controller-side six-hour cleanup guard bounds spend even if orchestration stops.

write_state.cluster_reset: A/A2: clear owned user keys before each separate one-workload client campaign; each arm uses a fresh, unique equal-width namespace with identical seeded logical key populations and overwrite-only timed writes. Global prefix growth across the18 runs is bounded, retained and counterbalanced, not asserted globally equal. B/C/D: clear this owned cluster user keyspace between fresh arm processes after clients exit, await commit, cooldown then quiescence. Never clear system keys.
write_state.record_layer: Clear each benchmark subspace at every body invocation, including calibration, outside timer. Measured write body is fixed1000x: IDs0..999, one transaction+commit per record for SaveRecord/SaveRecordWithIndex/SaveSplitRecord. Untimed verification checks exact presence/population. No insert/overwrite mix is reported as one population.
write_state.sql_insert: Fresh schema for each body invocation. Fixed1000x: IDs1..1000, timestamp seconds cycle0..59 and deterministic evt labels, one autocommit INSERT per iteration. Verify count1000 and endpoint IDs outside timer; schema allocation and teardown are untimed.
write_state.client: Frozen Dataset.Seed and ValidateSeed before warmup. Set100 overwrites one prepared key per worker; batchset50 and batchset50x1000 overwrite50 distinct prepared worker-local keys per transaction. Deterministic warmup/measured payloads and exact persisted final-value validation. RYW is one noncommitted local Set+Get, not a durable transaction.

client_units.get100/get1000/get10000: one Transact callback/Get of the named value byte size; transaction API fast-path behavior is part of implementation
client_units.read1000: one read-only transaction/Get of one1000-byte value, NOT1000 reads

environment_policy.during_arm_receipts: CPU/steal counters, pressure, memory, disk/network totals, benchmark process and FDB process stats; sampler and runner pinned to housekeeping CPUs0-1.
environment_policy.environment_failure: Pre-arm threshold/build/profile/install conflict aborts that case campaign before another arm. During-arm missing telemetry, OOM, server unavailability or >1% steal on a client/server CPU in a complete1-second interval marks the entire balanced block contaminated and aborts that case; retain complete and incomplete data, do not present it as clean or rerun one arm.
environment_policy.historical_correctness_failure: Do not patch old production to make it benchmarkable. Report that tree/case as correctness-failed/not-comparable, retain its data, omit that case ratio, and continue only other predeclared cases. A final-tree correctness failure stops measurement for investigation.
environment_policy.restart_policy: No automatic retry after adverse timing or an aborted campaign. Any justified environmental restart needs a separately named protocol/campaign version and retained original artifacts.

remote_contract.fixture: 1000 Orders IDs0..999, price=id, quantity=id%7+1; VALUE price_idx; nil initial continuation; no store record versions; same committed fixture per process.
remote_contract.small: No padding, unsplit metadata, exactly1 data key-value per record.
remote_contract.split: 100000-byte deterministic padding plus protobuf fields; split-enabled metadata; exactly2 data key-values per record verified on all1000 rows.
remote_contract.limit1: TupleRangeAll and ReturnedRowLimit1; expected ID0 forward,999 reverse, terminal ReturnLimitReached.
remote_contract.rows10: TupleRangeBetween((100),(110)); IDs100..109 forward,109..100 reverse; no row limit; terminal SourceExhausted.
remote_contract.rows1000: TupleRangeAll drained; IDs0..999 forward or reversed; terminal SourceExhausted.
remote_contract.strictness: Only SCAN_AND_FETCH and strict USE_REMOTE_FETCH are timed; no fallback. Before/after untimed audits check ordered IDs/fields/checksums/chunks; strict remote openings>0, index scans0, record loads0; ordinary remote0/index scans>0 and completed loads positive.
remote_contract.skip: Final executor only: cell rows10 selects [100,113),13input rows; Skip3 returns10 IDs103..112 forward or109..100 reverse. Cell rows1000 is all1000 inputs, returning997 IDs3..999 forward or996..0 reverse. No returned-row limit; exhausted terminal. Ordinary eligible leaf gets Skip3, strict remote leaf gets Skip0 plus one outer Skip. Remote openings1 and entries returned+4; ordinary completed loads exactly returned. Labels do not imply identical input and output cardinalities.
remote_contract.sql: Explicit method on warmed pinned connection, noncovering IDX_A EXPLAIN on measured and audited connections; audited timer reset after warmup; ordinary remote0/record loads>0; strict remote>0/index0/record loads0; measured connection has no timer.
remote_contract.limitations: One FDB process/storage role cannot establish cross-storage-process or cross-machine benefit. Logical remote openings are not wire RPC counts.
